_comment: Registered parameters. Hashed into every run manifest. Decided 2026-08-07;
changepoint_min_contrast is in *z-normalized units*: the contrast is
computed on the type-normalized field, so the bound is scale-free and does
not depend on the judge's raw score range. The primary rule refuses to run
on unnormalized scores for exactly this reason — a bound in z-units applied
to raw scores would silently mean something else.
changepoint_min_seg: shortest admissible regime, in steps.
changepoint_boundary_fallback: a split landing at the first or last
admissible position isolates an endpoint rather than finding a regime, and
max_degenerate_cells: how many (subset x type) cells may be constant,
saturated, or near-binary before E0 calls the field unusable.
